#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class Main {
public:
    static int main() {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        int ans = Solution().solve(n);
        cout << ans << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
private:
    class Solution {
        static const int mod = (int)1e9 + 7;
    public:
        int solve(int n) {
            vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(2 * n + 1, vector<vector<int>>(2 * n + 1, vector<int>(2, 0)));
            dp[0][0][0] = 1;
            for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; ++depth) {
                int start_opened = depth & 1;
                for (int opened = start_opened; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
                    if (opened - 1 >= 0) {
                        dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1]) % mod;
                        dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0]) % mod;
                    }
                    if (opened + 1 <= n) {
                        dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1]) % mod;
                        dp[depth][opened][1] = (dp[depth][opened][1] + dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0]) % mod;
                    }
                    dp[depth][opened][0] = (dp[depth][opened][0] + 1) % mod;
                }
            }
            return dp[2 * n][0][1];
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    return Main::main();
}
